answer: The protocol enforces identity via a 512GB memory-hard working set requirement, ensuring honest nodes reach consensus while 1,000 fakes stall, unable to hold the nectar of valid state. A verifier challenges agents by requesting specific memory indices; failure to return data matching the marble-like precision of the working set triggers an immediate penalty. Every walnut-sized piece of logic must reside on a dedicated bus to prevent pooling. Honest participants pay 120 watts to maintain their status.
